description: This file defines functions and types related to trust plans for execution wrappers, including resolving wrapper chains, handling shell multiplexers, and blocking policies.

methods.name: blockedExecWrapperTrustPlan
methods.description: Creates a trust plan indicating a blocked execution wrapper with provided parameters.

methods.name: finalizeExecWrapperTrustPlan
methods.description: Finalizes and constructs an execution trust plan based on current parameters, determining if it's a shell wrapper executable.

methods.name: resolveExecWrapperTrustPlan
methods.description: Resolves the trust plan for execution wrappers, handling nested wrappers, shell multiplexers, and policy blocking.
